description: The purchase guide for this store, for clients that can only call tools. Read it BEFORE the first write (create_cart, complete_checkout): the ordered flow, what the agent and the person each provide, human approval, errors and recovery, receipts, and this store's payment methods and limits. Read-only. Optional `section` (default `overview`, which lists the others).

section.description: Which part of the guide to read. Default `overview` (the ordered flow and the hard rules, with an index of the other sections). `all` returns every section.

name: get_purchase_guide
